   a. Load reef.csv; drop rows missing protection_status or latitude.
   b. For each reef–year, compute:  
      • total_biomass = sum(size × quantity)  
      • weighted_mean_size = total_biomass / sum(quantity)
   c. Derive P/B using metabolic‐scaling:  
      P/B = a × (weighted_mean_size)^–0.25  
      – Set a to unity or calibrate a so that mean(P/B) across all reef‐years matches mean(prod/biomass) in the data.
   d. Classify regions by known upwelling boundary (e.g. latitude 26° N):  
      – North (strong upwelling) if latitude ≤ 26;  
      – South (weak upwelling) if latitude > 26.  
      (Use each reef‐year’s mean latitude.)
   e. Keep only reefs with ≥3 distinct survey years; form a balanced panel of reef×year.

2. Exploratory analysis:
   a. Plot kernel density and boxplots of derived P/B by region and protection_status.
   b. Scatterplot of P/B vs. weighted_mean_size to verify inverse scaling.
   c. Tabulate mean P/B by region & protection.

3. Mixed‐effects panel modeling:
   a. Specify the model:  
      P/B_ry = β0 + β1·I[South] + β2·I[protected] + β3·I[CaboPulmo] + β4·I[SinProtec] +  
               β5·I[South]×I[protected] + β6·I[South]×I[CaboPulmo] + β7·I[South]×I[SinProtec] +  
               γ·(year) + u_reef + ε_ry
   b. Estimate using a mixed‐effects package (random intercept u_reef; fixed effects for year, region, protection and their interactions).
   c. If convergence fails or singular, switch to GEE with reef clusters or OLS with reef‐clustered SE but retain all fixed effects.
   d. Cluster standard errors at the reef level.

4. Hypothesis testing and contrasts:
   a. Test β1>0 for main region effect (South vs. North).  
   b. Test β6 (South×CaboPulmo) and β7 (South×SinProtec) to assess regional modulation of protection.
   c. Use Wald tests for pairwise contrasts among combined categories (North‐CaboPulmo vs. South‐CaboPulmo, etc.).

5. Diagnostics and robustness checks:
   a. Check residuals for heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation (e.g. Breusch–Pagan, Durbin–Watson).  
   b. Re‐estimate with alternative scalings (e.g. P/B = a·(mean_size)^–0.3 or raw prod/biomass) for sensitivity.
   c. Verify no high‐leverage or influential reef‐years driving results.

6. Visualization of fitted effects:
   a. Interaction plot: predicted P/B by protection_status for North vs. South with 95% CI.  
   b. Heatmap or 3‐D surface of P/B across continuous latitude and protection categories.

7. Interpretation:
   – Summarize magnitude and significance of region effect and its interaction with protection.
   – Discuss consistency with upwelling subsidy theory and management implications.

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
import statsmodels.api as sm

# 1. Data preparation and region classification
# a. Load data
df = pd.read_csv('reef.csv')
# Drop missing protection_status or latitude/degree
lat_col = 'latitude' if 'latitude' in df.columns else ('degree' if 'degree' in df.columns else None)
if lat_col is None:
    raise ValueError('No latitude column found')
df = df.dropna(subset=['protection_status', lat_col])

# b. Compute reef-year summaries
grp = df.groupby(['reef', 'protection_status', 'year'])
sum_stats = grp.apply(lambda g: pd.Series({
    'total_biomass': (g['size'] * g['quantity']).sum(),
    'weighted_mean_size': ((g['size'] * g['quantity']).sum() / g['quantity'].sum()),
    'mean_lat': g[lat_col].mean(),
    'raw_PBratio': g['prod'].sum() / ((g['size'] * g['quantity']).sum())
})).reset_index()

# c. Calibrate P/B scaling: P/B = a * size^-0.25 such that mean matches raw
target = sum_stats['raw_PBratio'].mean()
scale_mean = (sum_stats['weighted_mean_size'] ** -0.25).mean()
a = target / scale_mean
sum_stats['derived_PBratio'] = a * (sum_stats['weighted_mean_size'] ** -0.25)

# d. Classify regions by latitude boundary at 26°N
def region_class(lat):
    return 'North' if lat <= 26 else 'South'
sum_stats['region'] = sum_stats['mean_lat'].apply(region_class)

# e. Keep reefs with >=3 distinct survey years
year_counts = sum_stats.groupby('reef')['year'].nunique()
good_reefs = year_counts[year_counts >= 3].index
data = sum_stats[sum_stats['reef'].isin(good_reefs)].copy()
# Numeric year for modeling
data['year_num'] = data['year'] - data['year'].min()

# 2. Exploratory analysis
# a. Boxplots of P/B by region and protection_status
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.boxplot(data=data, x='region', y='derived_PBratio', hue='protection_status')
plt.title('Derived P/B by Region and Protection')
plt.ylabel('Derived P/B Ratio')
plt.xlabel('Region')
plt.legend(title='Protection Status')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# b. Density plots
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.kdeplot(data=data, x='derived_PBratio', hue='region', common_norm=False)
plt.title('Density of Derived P/B by Region')
plt.xlabel('Derived P/B Ratio')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# c. Scatter of P/B vs. mean size
plt.figure(figsize=(6,6))
sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='weighted_mean_size', y='derived_PBratio', hue='region')
plt.xscale('log')
plt.title('P/B vs. Weighted Mean Size')
plt.xlabel('Weighted Mean Size')
plt.ylabel('Derived P/B')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# d. Tabulate mean P/B by region and protection
pivot = data.pivot_table(values='derived_PBratio', index='region', columns='protection_status', aggfunc=['mean','std'])
print('Mean and SD of Derived P/B by Region and Protection:')
print(pivot)

# 3. Mixed-effects panel modeling
formula = 'derived_PBratio ~ C(region)*C(protection_status) + year_num'
try:
    md = smf.mixedlm(formula, data, groups=data['reef'])
    mdf = md.fit(reml=False)
    print('\nMixedLM Results:')
    print(mdf.summary())
    model = mdf
    use_ols = False
except Exception as e:
    print('MixedLM failed, using OLS with clustered SE.\nError:', e)
    ols = smf.ols(formula, data).fit(cov_type='cluster', cov_kwds={'groups': data['reef']})
    print('\nOLS (cluster robust) Results:')
    print(ols.summary())
    model = ols
    use_ols = True

# 4. Hypothesis testing: Wald tests
print('\nHypothesis Tests:')
tests = {
    'Main Region Effect (South vs North)': 'C(region)[T.South]=0',
    'Interaction: South x cabo pulmo': 'C(region)[T.South]:C(protection_status)[T.cabo pulmo]=0',
    'Interaction: South x sin proteccion': 'C(region)[T.South]:C(protection_status)[T.sin proteccion]=0'
}
for name, hypothesis in tests.items():
    try:
        res = model.t_test(hypothesis)
        print(f"{name}: coef={res.effect[0]:.4f}, p={res.pvalue:.3f}")
    except Exception:
        print(f"Could not test hypothesis '{name}'")

# 5. Visualization of fitted interaction effects
# Prepare grid for predictions
prots = data['protection_status'].unique()
regs = ['North','South']
mean_year = data['year_num'].mean()
grid = pd.DataFrame([(r,p,mean_year) for r in regs for p in prots],
                    columns=['region','protection_status','year_num'])
# Predict and, if OLS, get CIs
if use_ols:
    pred = model.get_prediction(grid).summary_frame()
    grid['fit'] = pred['mean']
    grid['ci_lower'] = pred['mean_ci_lower']
    grid['ci_upper'] = pred['mean_ci_upper']
else:
    grid['fit'] = model.predict(grid)
    grid['ci_lower'] = np.nan
    grid['ci_upper'] = np.nan

# Plot predictions
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.pointplot(data=grid, x='protection_status', y='fit', hue='region', dodge=True,
              join=False, capsize=0.1)
# Add error bars for OLS case
if use_ols:
    for i, row in grid.iterrows():
        x = np.where((prots == row['protection_status']))[0][0] + (0 if row['region']=='North' else 0.3)
        plt.plot([x, x], [row['ci_lower'], row['ci_upper']], color='gray')
plt.title('Predicted Derived P/B by Region and Protection')
plt.ylabel('Predicted P/B')
plt.xlabel('Protection Status')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

import seaborn as sns

# Drop missing protection_status or latitude/degree
lat_col = 'latitude' if 'latitude' in df.columns else ('degree' if 'degree' in df.columns else None)
if lat_col is None:
    raise ValueError('No latitude column found')
df = df.dropna(subset=['protection_status', lat_col])

# b. Compute reef-year summaries
grp = df.groupby(['reef', 'protection_status', 'year'])
sum_stats = grp.apply(lambda g: pd.Series({
    'total_biomass': (g['size'] * g['quantity']).sum(),
    'weighted_mean_size': ((g['size'] * g['quantity']).sum() / g['quantity'].sum()),
    'mean_lat': g[lat_col].mean(),
    'raw_PBratio': g['prod'].sum() / ((g['size'] * g['quantity']).sum())
})).reset_index()

# c. Calibrate P/B scaling: P/B = a * size^-0.25 such that mean matches raw
target = sum_stats['raw_PBratio'].mean()
scale_mean = (sum_stats['weighted_mean_size'] ** -0.25).mean()
a = target / scale_mean
sum_stats['derived_PBratio'] = a * (sum_stats['weighted_mean_size'] ** -0.25)

# d. Classify regions by latitude boundary at 26°N
def region_class(lat):
    return 'North' if lat <= 26 else 'South'
sum_stats['region'] = sum_stats['mean_lat'].apply(region_class)

# e. Keep reefs with >=3 distinct survey years
year_counts = sum_stats.groupby('reef')['year'].nunique()
good_reefs = year_counts[year_counts >= 3].index
data = sum_stats[sum_stats['reef'].isin(good_reefs)].copy()
# Numeric year for modeling
data['year_num'] = data['year'] - data['year'].min()

# 2. Exploratory analysis
# a. Boxplots of P/B by region and protection_status

sns.boxplot(data=data, x='region', y='derived_PBratio', hue='protection_status')
plt.title('Derived P/B by Region and Protection')
plt.ylabel('Derived P/B Ratio')
plt.xlabel('Region')
plt.legend(title='Protection Status')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# b. Density plots

sns.kdeplot(data=data, x='derived_PBratio', hue='region', common_norm=False)
plt.title('Density of Derived P/B by Region')
plt.xlabel('Derived P/B Ratio')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
